title: LynxDB documentation
description: Query log files and standard input with OpenSearch PPL, or run a LynxDB server that stores logs on disk.
lead: Query log files and standard input with OpenSearch PPL, or run a server to ingest and search logs from your services.

example.title: Count HTTP 5xx responses by service
example.command:
lynxdb query --file access.ndjson \
  --format csv --no-stats '
  source=main
  | where status >= 500
  | stats count() as errors by service'
